title: Re-record GMCP VC-203 evidence after today's core changes
goal: Core changes landed on 2026-11-12 (IPC rendezvous manifests, tempfile fold, sibling-revoke route lookup) changed files the GMCP checks read, so every VC-203 mastery test failed with stale evidence and the tasks whose acceptance includes gmcp_requirements could not pass. Re-run the checks with scripts/gmcp-record-evidence.sh (requirement phase, then --mastery) and commit the superseding records.
limitations: Evidence recorded on Linux x86_64 only.
Goes stale again when any file the GMCP checks read changes.

reuse.searched: scripts/gmcp-record-evidence.sh is the repository's own recorder; nothing new written.
